raw_text: The Indian Navy is aware of GPS anomalies reported by commercial shipping in the Andaman Sea and near the Strait of Malacca. INS Kadmatt has been deployed for electronic warfare reconnaissance in the affected area. The Indian Navy is working with international maritime authorities to investigate the source of the interference. Shipping operators are advised to exercise caution and use alternative navigation methods. Further updates will be provided as the investigation progresses.
